units.zh: 昔者聖人因天道以授人時，厘百工以熙庶政，步推之法，其來尚矣。
units.en: Long ago the sages took Heaven's Way to give mankind the seasons, set the hundred offices in order to brighten common affairs—and the arts of stepwise reckoning reach back to a remote antiquity.
units.literal: In antiquity the sages, taking Heaven's Way to grant mankind the seasons, ordered the hundred offices to brighten the multitude of government affairs—the methods of stepwise reckoning, their origin is remote indeed.

units.zh: 自漢太初迄于前宋，治曆者奚啻七十餘家，大概或百年或數十年，率一易焉。
units.en: From the Han Taichu era down to the former Song, calendar-makers numbered more than seventy houses; as a rule, every century or few decades brought a new system.
units.literal: From Han Taichu down to the former Song, calendar-makers were no fewer than seventy-odd houses; broadly, whether a century or several decades, on average there was one change.

units.zh: 蓋日月五星盈縮進退，與夫天運，至不齊也，人方制器以求之，以俾其齊，積寡至多，不能無爽故爾。
units.en: Sun, moon, and five stars swell and shrink, advance and retreat; Heaven's motion is never uniform. Men fashion reckonings to force alignment—but piling small errors into large ones, some discrepancy is inevitable.
units.literal: For sun, moon, and five stars have expansion, contraction, advance and retreat, and Heaven's motion is utterly uneven—men then fashion instruments to seek alignment, to make it even; but accumulating few into many, error cannot be avoided.

units.zh: 金有天下百餘年，曆惟一易。
units.en: Jin held the realm for a little over a century and changed its calendar only once.
units.literal: Jin held the realm for a hundred-odd years, and the calendar changed only once.

units.zh: 天會五年，司天楊級紹造《大明曆》，十五年春正月朔，始頒行之。
units.en: In Tianhui year 5 the Director of Heaven Yang Ji completed the Grand Clarity Calendar; in spring of year 15, on the new moon of the first month, it was first promulgated.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Tianhui, the Director of Heaven Yang Ji succeeded in making the "Grand Clarity Calendar"; in spring of the fifteenth year, first month new moon, it was first promulgated.

units.zh: 其法，以三億八千三百七十六萬八千六百五十七為曆元，五千二百三十為日法。
units.en: Its constants take 383,768,657 as the calendar origin and 5,230 as the day divisor.
units.literal: Its method: 383,768,657 as calendar origin; 5,230 as day divisor.

units.zh: 然其所本，不能詳究，或曰因宋《紀元曆》而增損之也。
units.en: Its sources cannot be traced in full; some say it was adapted from the Song Era Origin Calendar with additions and cuts.
units.literal: Yet its foundation cannot be traced in detail—or so it is said, it was augmented and reduced from the Song "Era Origin Calendar."

units.zh: 正隆戊寅三月辛酉朔，司天言日當食，而不食。
units.en: Zhenglong, wuyin year, third month, on xinyou, the new moon: the calendar office predicted an eclipse, but none occurred.
units.literal: Zhenglong, year wuyin, third month, on xinyou the new moon: the Director of Heaven said the sun should eclipse, but it did not.

units.zh: 大定癸巳五月壬辰朔，日食，甲午十一月甲申朔，日食，加時皆先天。
units.en: Dading guisi, fifth month, on renchen, the new moon—a solar eclipse; jiawu, eleventh month, on jiashen, the new moon—another eclipse; in both cases the predicted time came before the event.
units.literal: Dading guisi, fifth month on renchen the new moon—solar eclipse; jiawu, eleventh month on jiashen the new moon—solar eclipse; in each case the predicted hour came before the event.

units.zh: 丁酉九月丁酉朔，食乃後天。
units.en: Dingyou, ninth month, on dingyou, the new moon—the eclipse came after the predicted hour.
units.literal: Dingyou, ninth month, on dingyou the new moon—the eclipse came after the predicted hour.

units.zh: 由是占候漸差，乃命司天監趙知微重修《大明曆》，十一年曆成。
units.en: Prognostication and observation drifted apart; Zhao Zhiwei, Director of the Astronomical Directorate, was therefore ordered to revise the Grand Clarity Calendar, and in the eleventh year the calendar was completed.
units.literal: From this prognostication and observation drifted; therefore Zhao Zhiwei, Director of the Astronomical Directorate, was ordered to revise the Grand Clarity Calendar—it was completed in the eleventh year.

units.zh: 時翰林應奉耶律履亦造《乙未曆》。
units.en: At the same time Hanlin Attendant Yelü Lü also devised the Yiwei Calendar.
units.literal: At that time Hanlin Attendant Yelü Lü also devised the "Yiwei Calendar."

units.zh: 二十一年十一月望，太陰虧食，遂命尚書省委禮部員外郎任忠傑與司天曆官驗所食時刻分秒，比校知微、履及見行曆之親疏，以知微曆為親，遂用之。
units.en: In year 21, at the full moon of the eleventh month, the moon was eclipsed; the Ministry ordered Ren Zhongjie of the Rites Bureau and the calendar officers to verify the hour, minute, and second of the eclipse and compare Zhao Zhiwei's, Yelü Lü's, and the current calendar—Zhiwei's proved closer, and his calendar was adopted.
units.literal: Twenty-first year, eleventh month full moon, the moon suffered eclipse; therefore ordered Ministry of Rites Vice Director Ren Zhongjie with calendar officers to verify the hour, minute, and second of the eclipse, compare the closeness of Zhiwei's, Lü's, and the current calendars—Zhiwei's was closer, and it was adopted.

units.zh: 明昌初，司天又改進新曆，禮部郎中張行簡言：「請俟他日月食，覆校無差，然後用之。」
units.en: Early in Mingchang the calendar office proposed yet another revision; Zhang Xingjian, Director of the Ministry of Rites, said, "Please wait for another solar or lunar eclipse, re-check until there is no discrepancy, and only then adopt it."
units.literal: Early Mingchang, the Directorate again reformed a new calendar; Zhang Xingjian, Director of Rites, said: "Please wait for another solar or lunar eclipse, re-verify without discrepancy, then use it."

units.zh: 事遂寢。
units.en: The proposal was shelved.
units.literal: The matter was then shelved.

units.zh: 是以終金之世，惟用知微曆，我朝初亦用之，後始改《授時曆》焉。
units.en: Through the whole Jin age only Zhao Zhiwei's calendar was used; our dynasty used it at first as well, then replaced it with the Season-Granting Calendar.
units.literal: Thus through Jin's age only Zhiwei's calendar was used; our dynasty at first used it too, then changed to the Season-Granting Calendar.

units.zh: 今其書存乎太史，采而錄之，以為《曆志》。
units.en: Its text still rests with the Grand Astrologer; we have gathered and recorded it here as the Calendar Treatise.
units.literal: Now its text remains with the Grand Astrologer; we gather and record it as the Calendar Treatise.

units.literal: Procedures for qi and new moon, part one.

units.zh: 求天正冬至
units.en: To find the winter solstice of the celestial standard year.
units.literal: To find the winter solstice of the celestial standard year.

units.zh: 置上元甲子以來積年，歲實乘之，為通積分。
units.en: Set the accumulated years since upper origin jiazi, multiply by the tropical year dividend to obtain the general accumulated parts.
units.literal: Set accumulated years from upper origin jiazi, multiply by tropical year dividend to make general accumulated parts.

units.zh: 滿旬周去之，不盡以日法約之為日，不盈為餘，命甲子算外，即所求天正冬至日大小餘。
units.en: Cast out full ten-day circuits; divide the remainder by the day divisor for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder; count outside jiazi—that yields the greater and lesser remainders for the celestial-standard winter solstice.
units.literal: Remove when full of ten-day circuit; divide the remainder by day divisor for days, what does not fill is remainder; count outside jiazi—winter solstice greater and lesser remainders.

units.zh: 求次氣
units.en: To find successive qi.
units.literal: To find successive qi.

units.zh: 置天正冬至大小餘，以氣策累加之，秒盈秒母從分，分滿日法從日，即得次氣日及餘秒。
units.en: Set the winter solstice greater and lesser remainders and add the qi stride cumulatively; when seconds fill the second parent they carry into parts, when parts fill the day divisor they carry into days—thus each successive qi day with its remainder and seconds.
units.literal: Set winter solstice greater and lesser remainders, cumulatively add qi stride; when seconds fill second parent carry to parts, when parts fill day divisor carry to days—successive qi days and remainder-seconds.

units.zh: 求天正經朔
units.en: To find the canonical new moon of the celestial standard year.
units.literal: To find the canonical new moon of the celestial standard year.

units.zh: 以朔實去通積分，不盡為閏餘，以減通積分為朔積分。
units.en: Divide the general accumulated parts by the new-moon dividend; the remainder is the intercalary remainder; subtract it from the general accumulated parts to obtain the new-moon accumulated parts.
units.literal: Remove general accumulated parts by new-moon dividend; the remainder is intercalary remainder; subtract from general accumulated parts to make new-moon accumulated parts.

units.zh: 滿旬周去之，不盡如日法而一為日，不盈為餘，即所求天正經大小餘也。
units.en: Cast out full ten-day circuits; divide the remainder by the day divisor for days, with the unfilled portion as the remainder—that yields the greater and lesser remainders for the celestial-standard canonical new moon.
units.literal: Remove when full of ten-day circuit; divide the remainder by day divisor for days, what does not fill is remainder—canonical greater and lesser remainders of the celestial-standard new moon.

units.zh: 求弦望及次朔
units.en: To find quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive new moons.
units.literal: To find quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive new moons.

units.zh: 置天正經朔大小餘，以象策累加之，即各得弦、望及次朔經日及餘秒也。
units.en: Set the canonical new moon greater and lesser remainders and add the phase stride cumulatively—each addition yields the quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive canonical days with their remainders and seconds.
units.literal: Set canonical new moon greater and lesser remainders, cumulatively add phase stride—each yields quarter-moon, full-moon, and successive canonical days with remainder-seconds.

units.zh: 求沒日
units.en: To find submergence days.
units.literal: To find submergence days.

units.zh: 置有沒之恆氣小餘，如沒限以上，為有沒之氣。
units.en: Take the lesser remainder of the constant qi that bears submergence; if it reaches the submergence limit or above, that qi has a submergence day.
units.literal: Set the lesser remainder of the constant qi that has submergence; if at or above submergence limit, that qi has submergence.

units.zh: 以秒母乘之，內其秒，用減四十七萬七千五百五十六，余滿六千八百五十六而一，所得並恆氣大餘，命為沒日。
units.en: Multiply by the second parent and include the seconds; subtract from 477,556; divide the remainder by 6,856 and add to the constant qi greater remainder—name the result as the submergence day.
units.literal: Multiply by second parent, include the seconds, subtract from 477,556; divide the remainder by 6,856 and add to the constant qi greater remainder—count as submergence day.

units.zh: 求滅日
units.en: To find extinction days.
units.literal: To find extinction days.

units.zh: 置有滅之朔小餘，經朔小餘不滿朔虛分者。
units.en: Take the lesser remainder of the new moon that bears extinction—when the canonical new moon lesser remainder falls short of the new-moon void fraction.
units.literal: Set the lesser remainder of the new moon that has extinction—when the canonical new moon lesser remainder does not fill the new-moon void fraction.

units.zh: 六因之，如四百九十一而一，所得並經朔大餘，命為滅日。
units.en: Multiply by six, divide by 491, add to the canonical new moon greater remainder—name the result as the extinction day.
units.literal: Multiply by six, divide by 491, add to canonical new moon greater remainder—count as extinction day.

units.zh: 求七十二候
units.en: To find the seventy-two hou.
units.literal: To find the seventy-two hou.

units.zh: 置中氣大小餘，命之為初候，以候策累加之，即次候及末候也。
units.en: Take the mid-qi major and minor remainders as the first hou; by cumulative addition of the hou rule you reach each subsequent hou and the final hou.
units.literal: Set the major and minor remainders of the mid-qi, designate them as the first hou; add the hou rule cumulatively, and you obtain the next hou and the last hou.

units.zh: 求六十四卦
units.en: To find the sixty-four hexagrams.
units.literal: To find the sixty-four hexagrams.

units.zh: 置中氣大小餘，命之為公卦；
units.en: Take the mid-qi major and minor remainders and designate them as the duke hexagram;
units.literal: Set the major and minor remainders of the mid-qi, designate them as the duke hexagram;

units.zh: 以卦策累加之，得辟卦；
units.en: by cumulative addition of the hexagram rule you obtain the lord hexagram;
units.literal: add the hexagram rule cumulatively to obtain the lord hexagram;

units.zh: 又加之，得侯內卦。
units.en: add again to obtain the marquis inner hexagram.
units.literal: add again to obtain the marquis inner hexagram.

units.zh: 以貞策加之，得節氣之初，為侯外卦；
units.en: add the zhen rule to reach the start of the qi-period, the marquis outer hexagram;
units.literal: add the zhen rule to obtain the beginning of the qi-period, as the marquis outer hexagram;

units.zh: 又以貞策加之，得大夫卦。
units.en: add the zhen rule again to obtain the grandee hexagram.
units.literal: add the zhen rule again to obtain the grandee hexagram.

units.zh: 又以卦策加之，為卿卦。
units.en: add the hexagram rule again for the minister hexagram.
units.literal: add the hexagram rule again for the minister hexagram.

units.zh: 求土王用事
units.en: To find the Earth ruler's dominion.
units.literal: To find the Earth ruler's dominion.

units.zh: 以貞策減四季中氣大小餘，即土王用事日也。
units.en: Subtract the zhen rule from each season's mid-qi major and minor remainders to obtain the Earth ruler's dominion day.
units.literal: Subtract the zhen rule from the major and minor remainders of the four seasons' mid-qi, and that is the day of the Earth ruler's dominion.

units.zh: 求發斂
units.en: To find expansion and contraction.
units.literal: To find expansion and contraction.

units.zh: 置小餘，以六因之，如辰法而一為辰。
units.en: Set the minor remainder, multiply by six, and divide by the chen divisor to obtain the chen number.
units.literal: Set the minor remainder, multiply it by six, and divide by the chen divisor for one to obtain the chen.

units.zh: 如不盡，以刻法除之為刻。
units.en: If any remainder remains, divide it by the ke divisor to obtain ke.
units.literal: If not exhausted, divide by the ke divisor for ke.

units.zh: 命子下算外，即得加時所在辰刻及分。

units.literal: Count from zi below the stem sequence, and you obtain the double-hour, ke, and fen of the added time.

units.zh: 如加半辰法，即命子刻初。

units.literal: If the half-chen divisor is added, count from the start of the zi ke.

units.zh: 求每日盈縮朓朒
units.en: To find the daily excess–deficit and tuoke.
units.literal: To find the daily excess–deficit and tuoke.

units.zh: 各置其氣損益率，求盈縮之損益，求朒磕用朒磕之損益。

units.literal: Set each qi-period's gain-and-loss rate; find the gain and loss of excess–deficit; for tuoke use the tuoke gain-and-loss rate.

units.zh: 六因，如象限而一，為氣中率。
units.en: Multiply by six and divide by the quadrant limit to obtain the mid-qi rate.
units.literal: Multiply by six and divide by the quadrant limit for one to obtain the mid-qi rate.

units.zh: 與後氣中率相減，為合差。
units.en: Subtract from the next qi-period's mid-qi rate to obtain the combined difference.
units.literal: Subtract it from the following qi-period's mid-qi rate to obtain the combined difference.

units.zh: 半合差加減其氣中率，為初末泛率。
units.en: Add or subtract half the combined difference from the mid-qi rate to obtain the initial and final general rates.
units.literal: Add or subtract half the combined difference to the mid-qi rate to obtain the initial and final general rates.

units.zh: 至後：加初，減末。
units.en: After a solstice: add to the initial, subtract from the final.
units.literal: After a solstice: add to the initial, subtract from the final.

units.zh: 分後：減初，加末。
units.en: After an equinox: subtract from the initial, add to the final.
units.literal: After an equinox: subtract from the initial, add to the final.

units.zh: 又置合差，六因，如象限而一，為日，半之，加減初未泛率，為初末定率。
units.en: Set the combined difference, multiply by six, divide by the quadrant limit for days; halve and add or subtract from the initial and final general rates to obtain the initial and final fixed rates.
units.literal: Set the combined difference again, multiply by six, divide by the quadrant limit for one to obtain days; halve it and add or subtract from the initial and final general rates to obtain the initial and final fixed rates.

units.zh: 至後：減初，加末。
units.en: After a solstice: subtract from the initial, add to the final.
units.literal: After a solstice: subtract from the initial, add to the final.

units.zh: 分後：加初，減末。
units.en: After an equinox: add to the initial, subtract from the final.
units.literal: After an equinox: add to the initial, subtract from the final.

units.zh: 以日差累加減其氣初末定率，為每日損益分。
units.en: By cumulative daily difference add and subtract the qi-period's initial and final fixed rates to obtain the daily gain-and-loss parts.
units.literal: Accumulate the daily difference to add and subtract the qi-period's initial and final fixed rates, obtaining the daily gain-and-loss parts.

units.zh: 至後減，分後加。
units.en: After a solstice subtract; after an equinox add.
units.literal: After a solstice subtract; after an equinox add.

units.zh: 各以每日損益分加減氣下盈縮、朒磕，為每日盈縮、朒磕二分前一氣元後率相減為合差者，皆用前氣合差。
units.en: Apply each day's gain-and-loss parts to adjust the qi-period's excess–deficit and tuoke accumulations for the daily values; whenever the combined difference derives from subtracting the preceding qi's original and following rates, use that preceding qi's combined difference.
units.literal: Each applies the daily gain-and-loss parts to add and subtract the qi-period's excess–deficit and tuoke below, obtaining the daily excess–deficit and tuoke; where the combined difference comes from subtracting the preceding qi-period's original and following rates, always use the preceding qi-period's combined difference.

units.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣
units.en: To find qi entry for major new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter.
units.literal: To find the major new moon, first quarter, full moon, and last quarter qi entry.

units.zh: 置天正閏餘，以日法除為日，不滿為餘，如氣策以下，以減氣策，為入大雪氣。
units.en: Set the Heavenly Origin intercalary remainder; divide by the day divisor for days and keep the remainder; if below the qi rule, subtract from the qi rule to obtain entry into Major Snow.
units.literal: Set the Heavenly Origin intercalary remainder, divide by the day divisor for days and the remainder for the remainder; if below the qi rule, subtract from the qi rule to obtain entry into Major Snow qi.

units.zh: 以上去之，餘亦減氣策，為入小雪氣。
units.en: Remove what is above; subtract the qi rule from the remainder again to obtain entry into Minor Snow.
units.literal: Remove what is above; subtract the qi rule from the remainder again to obtain entry into Minor Snow qi.

units.zh: 即得天正經朔入氣日及餘也。
units.en: This yields the day and remainder of the civil new year’s mean conjunction within its qi phase.
units.literal: Then obtain the civil new-year mean conjunction’s entry into qi day and remainder.

units.zh: 以象策累加之，滿氣策去之，即得弦、望入次氣日及餘。
units.en: Add the image strategy repeatedly; discard a full qi strategy each time to obtain the day and remainder within the next qi for first quarter and full moon.
units.literal: Accumulate adding the image strategy; when full remove the qi strategy—then obtain the first and second qi day and remainder for waxing and full moon.

units.zh: 因加，後朔入氣日及餘也。
units.en: Continue adding likewise to obtain each later conjunction’s day and remainder within its qi phase.
units.literal: By further addition, also the later conjunction’s entry into qi day and remainder.

units.zh: 求每日損益、盈縮、朒磕
units.en: Procedure to find each day’s deficit and surplus, expansion and contraction, and deficit–surfeit.
units.literal: Seek daily deficit and surplus, expansion and contraction, and deficit–surfeit.

units.zh: 以日差益加減損加減其氣初損益率，為每日損益率。
units.en: Apply the daily difference to add or subtract the initial qi-phase deficit–surplus rate and obtain the daily deficit–surplus rate.
units.literal: With the daily difference, add surplus and subtract deficit to add and subtract the qi-phase initial deficit–surplus rate, for the daily deficit–surplus rate.

units.zh: 馴積損益其氣盈縮、朒磕積，為每日盈、朒磕積。
units.en: Accumulate stepwise to adjust the qi-phase expansion–contraction and deficit–surfeit totals into the daily expansion and deficit–surfeit accumulations.
units.literal: In sequence accumulate to add and subtract the qi-phase expansion–contraction and deficit–surfeit accumulations, for the daily expansion and deficit–surfeit accumulations.

units.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣朒磕定數
units.en: Procedure to find the fixed deficit–surfeit number for mean conjunction and waxing and full moon within qi.
units.literal: Seek the mean conjunction, waxing and full moon entry into qi deficit–surfeit fixed number.

units.zh: 各以所入恆氣小餘，以乘其日損益率，如日法而一，以所損益其下朒磕積為定數。
units.en: Multiply the entered constant qi’s minor remainder by the daily deficit–surplus rate, divide by the day divisor, and apply the result to the underlying deficit–surfeit accumulation to obtain the fixed number.
units.literal: For each, take the minor remainder of the constant qi entered, multiply by its daily deficit–surplus rate, divide by one as the day divisor, and with that add or subtract the deficit–surfeit accumulation below for the fixed number.

units.zh: 赤道宿度
units.en: Equatorial lodge degrees.
units.literal: Equatorial lodge degrees.

units.zh: 斗二十五度 牛七度少 女十一度少 虛九度少秒六十八危十五度半室十七度壁八度太
units.en: Dipper 25°; Ox 7° minor; Maid 11° minor; Void 9° minor, 68″; Rooftop 15° half; Encampment 17°; Wall 8° major.
units.literal: Dipper 25°; Ox 7° minor; Maid 11° minor; Void 9° minor, 68″; Rooftop 15° half; Encampment 17°; Wall 8° major.

units.zh: 右北方七宿九十四度秒六十八
units.en: At right: the northern seven lodges total 94° 68″.
units.literal: At right: the northern seven lodges, 94°, 68″.

units.zh: 奎十六度半婁十二度胃十五度昴十一度少畢十七度少觜半度參十度半
units.en: Striding Man 16° half; Bond 12°; Stomach 15°; Hairy Head 11° minor; Net 17° minor; Beak 0.5°; Three Stars 10° half.
units.literal: Striding Man 16° half; Bond 12°; Stomach 15°; Hairy Head 11° minor; Net 17° minor; Beak 0.5°; Three Stars 10° half.

units.zh: 右西方七宿八十三度井三十三度少鬼二度半柳十三度太星六度太張十七度少翼十八度太 軫十七度
units.en: At right: the western seven lodges 83°; Well 33° minor; Ghost 2° half; Willow 13° major; Star 6° major; Extended Net 17° minor; Wings 18° major; Chariot Axis 17°.
units.literal: At right: the western seven lodges 83°; Well 33° minor; Ghost 2° half; Willow 13° major; Star 6° major; Extended Net 17° minor; Wings 18° major; Chariot Axis 17°.

units.zh: 右南方七宿一百九度少角十二度亢九度少氐一十六度房五度太心六度少尾十九度少箕十度半
units.en: At right: the southern seven lodges 109° minor; Horn 12°; Gullet 9° minor; Base 16°; Chamber 5° major; Heart 6° minor; Tail 19° minor; Winnowing Basket 10° half.
units.literal: At right: the southern seven lodges 109° minor; Horn 12°; Gullet 9° minor; Base 16°; Chamber 5° major; Heart 6° minor; Tail 19° minor; Winnowing Basket 10° half.

units.zh: 右東方七宿七十九度
units.en: At right: the eastern seven lodges total 79°.
units.literal: At right: the eastern seven lodges, 79°.

units.zh: 求冬至赤道日度
units.en: Procedure to find the winter solstice equatorial solar degree.
units.literal: Seek the winter solstice equatorial solar degree.

units.zh: 置通積分，以周天分去之，餘日法而一為度，不滿退除為分秒。
units.en: Set the general accumulated parts, subtract the circuit-of-heaven parts, divide the remainder by the day divisor for degrees, and convert the remainder into minutes and seconds.
units.literal: Set the general accumulated parts; remove the circuit-of-heaven parts; divide the remainder by the day divisor to one for degrees; what does not fill, retreat and remove for minutes and seconds.

units.zh: 以百為母。
units.en: Use one hundred as the denominator.
units.literal: Take one hundred as the denominator.

units.zh: 命起赤道虛宿七度外去之，至不滿宿，即所求年天正冬至加時日躔赤道度及分秒。
units.en: Count from beyond Void lodge 7° on the equator and discard full lodges; the lodge not yet filled gives the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds for the civil new year of the year sought.
units.literal: Count from beyond the seventh degree of equatorial Void lodge outward and remove; until a lodge is not filled—that is the sought year’s civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition solar motion equatorial degree and minutes and seconds.

units.zh: 求春分夏至秋分赤道日度
units.en: Procedure to find the equatorial solar degrees at spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox.
units.literal: Seek the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox equatorial solar degrees.

units.zh: 置天正冬至加時赤道日度，累加象限，滿赤道宿次去之，即各得春分、夏至、秋分加時日在宿度及分秒。
units.en: Set the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition, add the image quadrant repeatedly, and discard full equatorial cycles to obtain the equatorial lodge degrees and minutes and seconds at hour-of-addition for spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox.
units.literal: Set the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree; accumulate adding the image quadrant; when the equatorial lodge cycle is full remove it—then each obtain the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox hour-of-addition solar day-in-lodge degree and minutes and seconds.

units.zh: 求四正赤道宿積度
units.en: Procedure to find the accumulated equatorial degrees after the four cardinals.
units.literal: Seek the four-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degrees.

units.zh: 置四正赤道宿全度，以四正赤道日度及分減之，餘為距後度。
units.en: Set the full width of each cardinal equatorial lodge, subtract the cardinal equatorial solar degree and minutes, and the remainder is the post-cardinal distance.
units.literal: Set each four-cardinal equatorial lodge’s full degree; subtract the four-cardinal equatorial solar degree and minutes—the remainder is the degree after the cardinal.

units.zh: 以赤道宿度累加之，各得四正後赤道宿積度及分。
units.en: Add equatorial lodge widths cumulatively to obtain the accumulated equatorial degree and minutes after each cardinal.
units.literal: Accumulate adding equatorial lodge degrees—each obtains the post-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degree and minutes.

units.zh: 求赤道宿積度入初末限
units.en: Procedure to find whether an equatorial accumulated degree falls in the initial or terminal limit.
units.literal: Seek entry into initial and terminal limit for equatorial lodge accumulated degree.

units.zh: 視四正後赤道宿積度及分，在四十五度六十五分秒五十四半以下為入初限，以上者用減象限，餘為入末限。
units.en: If the post-cardinal equatorial accumulation is 45° 65′ 54.5″ or less, it is in the initial limit; otherwise subtract it from the image quadrant and the remainder is in the terminal limit.
units.literal: Inspect the post-cardinal equatorial lodge accumulated degree and minutes: at 45° 65′ 54.5″ and below is entry into the initial limit; above, subtract from the image quadrant—the remainder is entry into the terminal limit.

units.zh: 求二十宿黃道度
units.en: Procedure to find the ecliptic degrees of the twenty-eight lodges.
units.literal: Seek the twenty lodges’ ecliptic degrees.

units.zh: 以四正後赤道宿入初末限度及分，減一百一度，余以初末限度及分乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度。
units.en: Subtract the post-cardinal equatorial limit from 101°, multiply by the limit’s degrees and minutes, carry as needed, and convert hundreds into minutes and then into degrees.
units.literal: With the post-cardinal equatorial lodge’s degrees and minutes in the initial or terminal limit, subtract from 101°; multiply the remainder by the initial or terminal limit degrees and minutes; carry in division; when full of one hundred make minutes; when minutes are full of one hundred make degrees.

units.zh: 至後以減、分後以加赤道宿積度，為其宿黃道積度。
units.en: Subtract after winter solstice and add after the equinoxes to convert equatorial accumulation into ecliptic accumulation for each lodge.
units.literal: After the solstice subtract; after the equinox add—to the equatorial lodge accumulated degree for its lodge ecliptic accumulated degree.

units.zh: 以前宿黃道積度減之其四正之宿，先加象限，然後前宿減之。
units.en: Subtract the prior lodge’s ecliptic accumulation; for the four cardinal lodges, add the image quadrant first, then subtract the prior lodge.
units.literal: Subtract the prior lodge’s ecliptic accumulated degree; for the four cardinals’ lodges, first add the image quadrant, then subtract the prior lodge.

units.zh: 為其宿黃道度及分。
units.en: The result is that lodge’s ecliptic degree and minutes.
units.literal: This is its lodge ecliptic degree and minutes.

units.zh: 其分就約為太、半、少。
units.en: Round the minutes to major, half, and minor fractions.
units.literal: Its minutes are then approximated as major, half, and minor.

units.zh: 黃道宿度
units.en: Ecliptic lodge degrees.
units.literal: Ecliptic lodge degrees.

units.en: Dipper 23°; Ox 7°; Maid 11°; Void 9° minor, 68″; Rooftop 16°; Encampment 18° minor; Wall 9° half.
units.literal: Dipper 23°; Ox 7°; Maid 11°; Void 9° minor, 68″; Rooftop 16°; Encampment 18° minor; Wall 9° half.

units.zh: 右北方七宿九十四度六十八秒
units.en: At right: the northern seven lodges total 94° 68″.
units.literal: At right: the northern seven lodges, 94° 68″.

units.en: Striding Man 17° major; Bond 12° major; Stomach 15° half; Hairy Head 11°; Net 16° half; Beak 0.5°; Three Stars 9° major.
units.literal: Striding Man 17° major; Bond 12° major; Stomach 15° half; Hairy Head 11°; Net 16° half; Beak 0.5°; Three Stars 9° major.

units.en: At right: the western seven lodges 83° major; cumulative 177°, 75′, 68″.
units.literal: At right: the western seven lodges 83° major; 177°, 75′, 68″.

units.en: Well 30° half; Ghost 2° half; Willow 13° minor; Star 6° major; Extended Net 17° major; Wings 20°; Chariot Axis 18° half.
units.literal: Well 30° half; Ghost 2° half; Willow 13° minor; Star 6° major; Extended Net 17° major; Wings 20°; Chariot Axis 18° half.

units.en: At right: the southern seven lodges 109° minor; cumulative 287°, 68″.
units.literal: At right: the southern seven lodges 109° minor; 287°, 68″.

units.zh: 角十二度太亢九度太氐十六度少房五度太心六度尾十八度少箕九度半
units.en: Horn 12° major; Gullet 9° major; Base 16° minor; Chamber 5° major; Heart 6°; Tail 18° minor; Winnowing Basket 9° half.
units.literal: Horn 12° major; Gullet 9° major; Base 16° minor; Chamber 5° major; Heart 6°; Tail 18° minor; Winnowing Basket 9° half.

units.zh: 右東方七宿七十八度少三百六十五、二十五、六十八
units.en: At right: the eastern seven lodges 78° minor; cumulative 365°, 25′, 68″.
units.literal: At right: the eastern seven lodges 78° minor; 365°, 25′, 68″.

units.zh: 前黃道宿度，依今曆歲差所在算定。
units.en: The ecliptic lodge degrees above are determined by the present calendar’s precessional position.
units.literal: The foregoing ecliptic lodge degrees are fixed by calculation according to the present calendar’s precession.

units.zh: 如上考往古，下驗將來，當據歲差，每移一度，依術推變當時宿度，然後可步七曜，知其所在。
units.en: To check the past and test the future, rely on precession: whenever it shifts a degree, recalculate contemporary lodge degrees by the procedure—only then can the seven luminaries be stepped and their places known.
units.literal: To verify antiquity above and test the future below, one must rely on precession: for each degree it shifts, derive by the procedure the lodge degrees of that time—only then can one step the seven luminaries and know their positions.

units.zh: 求天正冬至加時黃道日度
units.en: Procedure to find the ecliptic solar degree at civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition.
units.literal: Seek the civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree.

units.zh: 以冬至加時赤道日度及分秒，減一百一度，餘以冬至赤度及分秒乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度。
units.en: Subtract 101° from the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition, multiply the remainder by that equatorial degree and its minutes and seconds, carry, and convert hundreds into minutes and then degrees.
units.literal: With the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds, subtract 101°; multiply the remainder by the winter solstice equatorial degree and minutes and seconds; carry in division; when full of one hundred make minutes; when minutes are full of one hundred make degrees.

units.zh: 命曰黃赤道差。
units.en: This is called the ecliptic–equator difference.
units.literal: Name it the yellow–red equator difference.

units.zh: 用減冬至加時赤道日度及分秒，即所求年天正冬至加時黃道日度及分秒。
units.en: Subtract that difference from the winter solstice equatorial degree at hour-of-addition to obtain the ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds at civil new-year winter solstice for the year sought.
units.literal: Subtract it from the winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial solar degree and minutes and seconds—that is the sought year’s civil new-year winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree and minutes and seconds.

units.zh: 求二十四氣加時黃道日度
units.en: Procedure to find the ecliptic solar degrees at hour-of-addition for all twenty-four qi.
units.literal: Seek the twenty-four qi hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degrees.

units.zh: 置所求年冬至日躔黃赤道差，以次年黃赤道差減之，餘以所求氣數乘之，二十四而一，所得以加其氣中積及約分，又以其氣初日盈縮數盈加縮減之，用加冬至加時黃道日度，依宿次去之，即各得其氣加時黃道日躔宿度及分秒。
units.en: Take the winter solstice ecliptic–equator difference for the year sought, subtract the next year’s difference, multiply the remainder by the qi number and divide by twenty-four, add to the qi’s central accumulation and approximate parts, adjust by the first-day expansion–contraction (surplus add, contraction subtract), add to the winter solstice ecliptic degree at hour-of-addition, and discard full lodge cycles to obtain each qi’s ecliptic solar lodge at hour-of-addition.
units.literal: Set the sought year’s winter solstice solar-motion yellow–red equator difference; subtract the next year’s yellow–red equator difference; multiply the remainder by the number of qi sought and divide by twenty-four; add the result to that qi’s central accumulation and approximate parts; also add or subtract according to that qi’s first-day expansion–contraction number, surplus adding and contraction subtracting; apply to the winter solstice hour-of-addition ecliptic solar degree; remove by lodge cycle in succession—then each obtains that qi’s hour-of-addition ecliptic solar motion lodge degree and minutes and seconds.

units.zh: 如其年冬至加時赤道宿度空分秒在歲差以下者，即加前宿全度，然後求黃赤道差，餘依術算。
units.en: If the winter solstice equatorial lodge at hour-of-addition has fractional minutes and seconds below the precessional threshold, add the prior lodge’s full width before computing the ecliptic–equator difference; otherwise follow the procedure as above.
units.literal: If that year’s winter solstice hour-of-addition equatorial lodge degree has empty minutes and seconds below the precession, add the prior lodge’s full degree, then seek the yellow–red equator difference; the remainder follows the procedure.

units.zh: 求二十四氣每日晨前夜半黃道日度
units.en: To find the daily ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight for each of the twenty-four qi.
units.literal: To find the ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight for each day of the twenty-four qi.

units.zh: 副置其氣小餘，以其氣初日損益率乘之，盈縮之損益。
units.en: Set aside the qi's minor remainder, multiply by that qi's first-day decrease-increase rate, and apply excess-and-deficit to the decrease and increase.
units.literal: Set aside its qi minor remainder; multiply by that qi's first-day decrease-increase rate; apply excess-and-deficit to the decrease and increase.

units.zh: 萬約之為分，應益者盈加縮減，應損者盈減縮加其副，日法除之為度，不滿退除為分秒，以減其氣加時黃道日度，即各得其氣初日晨前夜半黃道日度。
units.en: Reduce by ten thousand to obtain fen; for increase, excess-add and deficit-subtract; for decrease, excess-subtract and deficit-add the subsidiary; divide by the day factor for degrees, and any remainder steps back into fen and miao; subtract from that qi's added-hour ecliptic solar degree to obtain each qi's first-day ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight.
units.literal: Reduce by ten thousand to make fen; where increase applies, excess-add and deficit-subtract; where decrease applies, excess-subtract and deficit-add the subsidiary; divide by the day factor for degrees; what does not fill, step back and divide for fen and miao; subtract from that qi's added-hour ecliptic solar degree — thus obtain each qi's first-day ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight.

units.zh: 每日加一度，以百約每日損益率，盈縮之損益。
units.en: Add one degree each day, reduce the daily decrease-increase rate by one hundred, and apply excess-and-deficit to the decrease and increase.
units.literal: Each day add one degree; reduce the daily decrease-increase rate by one hundred; apply excess-and-deficit to the decrease and increase.

units.zh: 應益者盈加縮減，應損者盈減縮加，為每日晨前夜半黃道日度及分秒。
units.en: For increase, excess-add and deficit-subtract; for decrease, excess-subtract and deficit-add — yielding the daily ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight with fen and miao.
units.literal: Where increase applies, excess-add and deficit-subtract; where decrease applies, excess-subtract and deficit-add — these are the daily ecliptic solar degrees before dawn and at midnight with fen and miao.

units.zh: 求每日午中黃道日度
units.en: To find the daily noon ecliptic solar degree.
units.literal: To find the daily noon ecliptic solar degree.

units.zh: 置一萬分，以所入氣日盈縮損益率，應益者盈加縮減，應損者盈減縮加，皆加減損益率，餘半之，滿百為分，不滿為秒，以加其日清晨前夜半黃道日度，即其日午中日躔黃道宿度及分秒。
units.en: Set ten thousand fen, take the entered qi's daily excess-deficit decrease-increase rate, and for increase excess-add and deficit-subtract, for decrease excess-subtract and deficit-add; add and subtract the decrease-increase rate throughout, halve the remainder, convert hundreds to fen and the remainder to miao, and add to that day's early-morning before-dawn ecliptic solar degree to obtain the noon solar progression ecliptic lodge degree with fen and miao.
units.literal: Set ten thousand fen; take the entered qi's daily excess-deficit decrease-increase rate; where increase applies, excess-add and deficit-subtract; where decrease applies, excess-subtract and deficit-add; all add and subtract the decrease-increase rate; halve the remainder; what fills one hundred becomes fen, what does not fill becomes miao; add to that day's early-morning before-dawn ecliptic solar degree — that is the day's noon solar progression ecliptic lodge degree with fen and miao.

units.zh: 求每日午中黃道積度
units.en: To find the daily noon accumulated ecliptic degree.
units.literal: To find the daily noon accumulated ecliptic degree.

units.zh: 以二至加時黃道日度，距至所求日午中黃道日度，為入二至後黃道積度及分秒。
units.en: From the solstice added-hour ecliptic solar degree, measure to the sought day's noon ecliptic solar degree to obtain the accumulated ecliptic degree after the solstice, with fen and miao.
units.literal: Take the solstice added-hour ecliptic solar degree; the distance from the solstice to the sought day's noon ecliptic solar degree is the accumulated ecliptic degree after entering the solstice, with fen and miao.

units.zh: 每日午中黃道入初末限
units.en: Daily noon ecliptic entry into initial and final limits.
units.literal: Daily noon ecliptic entry into initial and final limits.

units.zh: 視二至後黃道積度，在四十三度一十二分秒八十七以下為初限，以上用減象限，餘為入末限。
units.en: For accumulated ecliptic degree after a solstice: at 43°12′87″ or below, it is the initial limit; above that, subtract the quadrant limit and the remainder is entry into the final limit.
units.literal: Observe the accumulated ecliptic degree after the solstice: at forty-three degrees twelve fen eighty-seven miao or below it is the initial limit; above that, subtract the quadrant limit; the remainder is entry into the final limit.

units.zh: 其積度滿象限去之，為二分後黃道積度，在四十八度一十八分秒二十二以下為初限，以上用減象限，餘為入末限。
units.en: When the accumulated degree fills the quadrant limit, remove it to obtain the post-equinox accumulated ecliptic degree; at 48°18′22″ or below it is the initial limit; above that, subtract the quadrant limit and the remainder is entry into the final limit.
units.literal: When the accumulated degree fills the quadrant limit, remove it — that is the accumulated ecliptic degree after the equinox; at forty-eight degrees eighteen fen twenty-two miao or below it is the initial limit; above that, subtract the quadrant limit; the remainder is entry into the final limit.

units.zh: 求每日午中赤道日度
units.en: To find the daily noon equatorial solar degree.
units.literal: To find the daily noon equatorial solar degree.

units.zh: 以所求日午中黃道積度，入至後初限，分後末限，度及分秒，進三位，加二十萬二千五十少，開平方除之，所得減去四百四十九半，余在初限者，直以二至赤道日度加而命之。
units.en: Take the sought day's noon accumulated ecliptic degree — after a solstice in the initial limit, after an equinox in the final limit — with degrees, fen, and miao; advance three places, add 202,050 and a fraction less, take the square root and divide; subtract 449.5; if in the initial limit, add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree directly and assign the mansions.
units.literal: Take the sought day's noon accumulated ecliptic degree, entering after the solstice the initial limit and after the equinox the final limit, with degrees fen and miao; advance three places, add 202,050 and a fraction less, extract the square root and divide by it; subtract 449.5 from the result; if in the initial limit, directly add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree and assign the mansions.

units.zh: 在末限者，以減象限，餘以二分赤道日度加而命之。
units.en: If in the final limit, subtract the quadrant limit, add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree to the remainder, and assign the mansions.
units.literal: If in the final limit, subtract the quadrant limit; with the remainder add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree and assign the mansions.

units.zh: 即每日午中赤道日度。
units.en: That yields the daily noon equatorial solar degree.
units.literal: That is the daily noon equatorial solar degree.

units.zh: 以所求日午中黃道積度，入至後末限，分後初限，度及分秒，進三位，用減三十萬三千五十少，開平方除之，所得，以減五百五十半，其在初限者，以所減之餘，直以二分赤道日度加而命之。
units.en: Take the sought day's noon accumulated ecliptic degree — after a solstice in the final limit, after an equinox in the initial limit — with degrees, fen, and miao; advance three places, subtract 303,050 and a fraction less, take the square root and divide; subtract 550.5; if in the initial limit, add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree to the remainder and assign the mansions.
units.literal: Take the sought day's noon accumulated ecliptic degree, entering after the solstice the final limit and after the equinox the initial limit, with degrees fen and miao; advance three places, subtract 303,050 and a fraction less, extract the square root and divide by it; subtract 550.5 from the result; if in the initial limit, add the two-equinox equatorial solar degree directly to the remainder and assign the mansions.

units.zh: 在末限者，以減象限，餘以二至赤道日度加而命之。
units.en: If in the final limit, subtract the quadrant limit, add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree to the remainder, and assign the mansions.
units.literal: If in the final limit, subtract the quadrant limit; with the remainder add the two-solstice equatorial solar degree and assign the mansions.

units.zh: 即每日午中赤道日度。
units.en: That yields the daily noon equatorial solar degree.
units.literal: That is the daily noon equatorial solar degree.

units.en: Autumn Equinox — beyond 10°44′5″ of Chariot, enters the Zheng allotment, Shouxing station, sign at chen.
units.literal: Autumn Equinox — beyond Chariot 10 degrees 44 fen 5 miao, enters the Zheng allotment, Shouxing station, celestial sign at chen.

units.zh: 霜降，氐一度七十七分七十七秒外，入宋分，大火之次，辰在卯。
units.en: Frost Descent — beyond 1°77′77″ of Root, enters the Song allotment, Dahu station, sign at mao.
units.literal: Frost Descent — beyond Root 1 degree 77 fen 77 miao, enters the Song allotment, Dahu station, celestial sign at mao.

units.en: Lesser Snow — beyond 3°97′92″ of Tail, enters the Yan allotment, Ximu station, sign at yin.
units.literal: Lesser Snow — beyond Tail 3 degrees 97 fen 92 miao, enters the Yan allotment, Ximu station, celestial sign at yin.

units.en: Winter Solstice — beyond 4°36′66″ of Dipper, enters the Wu-Yue allotment, Xingji station, sign at chou.
units.literal: Winter Solstice — beyond Dipper 4 degrees 36 fen 66 miao, enters the Wu-Yue allotment, Xingji station, celestial sign at chou.

units.zh: 大寒，女二度九十一分九十一秒外，入齊分，玄枵之次，辰在子。
units.en: Greater Cold — beyond 2°91′91″ of Woman, enters the Qi allotment, Xuanxiao station, sign at zi.
units.literal: Greater Cold — beyond Woman 2 degrees 91 fen 91 miao, enters the Qi allotment, Xuanxiao station, celestial sign at zi.

units.zh: 求入宮時刻
units.en: To find the time of entering the palace.
units.literal: To find the time of entering the palace.

units.zh: 各置入宮宿度及分秒，以其日晨前夜半日度減之，相近一度之間者求之。
units.en: Set each palace-entry lodge degree with fen and miao, subtract that day's before-dawn solar degree, and find where the remainder falls within one degree.
units.literal: For each, set the palace-entry lodge degree with fen and miao; subtract from that day's before-dawn solar degree; seek where the remainder lies within one degree.

units.zh: 餘以日法乘其分，其秒從於下，亦通乘之，為實；
units.en: Multiply the remainder's fen by the day factor, carry the miao below and multiply through likewise to form the dividend;
units.literal: With the remainder multiply its fen by the day factor; the miao follow below and are likewise multiplied through — this is the dividend;

units.zh: 以其日太陽行分為法，實如法而一，所得，依發斂加時求之，即得其日太陽入宮時刻及分秒。
units.en: use that day's solar motion fen as divisor; divide; then seek by emission-and-absorption timing to obtain that day's solar palace-entry time with fen and miao.
units.literal: take that day's solar motion fen as the divisor; divide the dividend by the divisor; obtain the result; seek by emission and absorption of time — thus obtain that day's solar time of entering the palace with fen and miao.

units.zh: ○步晷漏第四
units.en: ○ Procedure for Gnomon and Clepsydra, Fourth.
units.literal: ○ Procedure for Gnomon and Clepsydra, Fourth.

units.zh: 中限：一百八十二日，六十二分，一十八秒。
units.en: Central limit: 182 days, 62 fen, 18 miao.
units.literal: Central limit: 182 days, 62 fen, 18 miao.

units.zh: 冬至初限，夏至末限：六十二日，二十分。
units.en: Winter-solstice initial limit, summer-solstice final limit: 62 days, 20 fen.
units.literal: Winter-solstice initial limit, summer-solstice final limit: 62 days, 20 fen.

units.zh: 夏至初限，冬至末限：一百二十日，四十二分。
units.en: Summer-solstice initial limit, winter-solstice final limit: 120 days, 42 fen.
units.literal: Summer-solstice initial limit, winter-solstice final limit: 120 days, 42 fen.

units.zh: 冬至地中晷影常數：一丈二尺八寸三分。
units.en: Winter-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 3 fen.
units.literal: Winter-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant: 1 zhang 2 chi 8 cun 3 fen.

units.zh: 夏至地中晷影常數：一尺五寸六分。
units.en: Summer-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant: 1 chi 5 cun 6 fen.
units.literal: Summer-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant: 1 chi 5 cun 6 fen.

units.zh: 周法：一千四百二十八。
units.en: Circumference factor: 1,428.
units.literal: Circumference factor: 1,428.

units.zh: 內外法：一萬八百九十六。
units.en: Inner-outer factor: 10,896.
units.literal: Inner-outer factor: 10,896.

units.zh: 半法：二千六百一十五。
units.en: Half factor: 2,615.
units.literal: Half factor: 2,615.

units.zh: 日法：四分之三：三千九百二十二半。
units.en: Day factor, three-fourths: 3,922.5.
units.literal: Day factor, three-fourths: 3,922.5.

units.zh: 日法：四分之一：一千三百七半。
units.en: Day factor, one-fourth: 1,307.5.
units.literal: Day factor, one-fourth: 1,307.5.

units.zh: 昏明分：一百三十分，七十五秒。
units.en: Dusk-and-dawn fen: 130 fen, 75 miao.
units.literal: Dusk-and-dawn fen: 130 fen, 75 miao.

units.zh: 昏明刻：二刻，一百五十六分，九十秒。
units.en: Dusk-and-dawn ke: 2 ke, 156 fen, 90 miao.
units.literal: Dusk-and-dawn ke: 2 ke, 156 fen, 90 miao.

units.zh: 刻法：三百一十三分，八十秒。
units.en: Ke factor: 313 fen, 80 miao.
units.literal: Ke factor: 313 fen, 80 miao.

units.zh: 秒母：一百。
units.en: Miao mother: 100.
units.literal: Miao mother: 100.

units.zh: 求午中入氣中積
units.en: To find the noon mid-accumulation within qi.
units.literal: To find the noon mid-accumulation within qi.

units.zh: 置所求日大餘及半法，以所入之氣大小餘減之，為其日午中入氣。
units.en: Set the sought day's greater remainder and half factor, subtract the entered qi's greater and lesser remainders, and obtain that day's noon entry into qi.
units.literal: Set the sought day's greater remainder and half factor; subtract the entered qi's greater and lesser remainders — that is the day's noon entry into qi.

units.zh: 以加其氣中積，為其日午中中積。
units.en: Add that to the qi mid-accumulation to obtain the day's noon mid-accumulation.
units.literal: Add to its qi mid-accumulation — that is the day's noon mid-accumulation.

units.zh: 小餘以日法除為約分。
units.en: Divide the lesser remainder by the day factor to obtain approximate fen.
units.literal: Divide the lesser remainder by the day factor for approximate fen.

units.zh: 求二至後午中入初末限
units.en: To find noon entry into initial and final limits after the two solstices.
units.literal: To find noon entry into initial and final limits after the two solstices.

units.zh: 置午中中積及分，如中限以下，為冬至後。
units.en: Set the noon mid-accumulation and fen; at or below the central limit counts as after winter solstice.
units.literal: Set the noon mid-accumulation and fen; if at or below the central limit, it is after winter solstice.

units.zh: 以上去中限，為夏至後。
units.en: If above, subtract the central limit — after summer solstice.
units.literal: If above, remove the central limit — after summer solstice.

units.zh: 其二至後，如在初限以下，為初限。
units.en: Within each solstice period, at or below the initial limit counts as the initial limit.
units.literal: For the two solstice periods, if at or below the initial limit, it is the initial limit.

units.zh: 以上覆減中限，餘為入末限也。
units.en: If above, cover and subtract the central limit; the remainder is entry into the final limit.
units.literal: If above, cover and subtract the central limit; the remainder is entry into the final limit.

units.zh: 求午中晷影定數
units.en: To find the noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.
units.literal: To find the noon gnomon-shadow fixed number.

units.zh: 視冬至後初限、夏至後末限，百通日，內分，自相乘，副置之。
units.en: After winter solstice in the initial limit or after summer solstice in the final limit: multiply the day count by one hundred, include the fen, square the product, and set it aside.
units.literal: For after winter solstice in the initial limit and after summer solstice in the final limit: multiply the day count by one hundred and include the fen, self-multiply, and set aside as subsidiary.

units.zh: 以一千四百五十除之，所得加五萬三百八十，折半限分並之；
units.en: Divide by 1,450, add the quotient to 50,380, and combine with half the limit fen;
units.literal: Divide by 1,450; add the result to 50,380, combine with half the limit fen;

units.zh: 除其副為分。
units.en: divide the subsidiary by that sum to obtain fen.
units.literal: divide the subsidiary by it for fen.

units.zh: 分滿十為寸，寸滿十為尺，用減冬至地中晷影常數，為所求晷影定數。
units.en: Ten fen make one cun and ten cun one chi; subtract from the winter-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant to obtain the sought gnomon-shadow fixed number.
units.literal: When fen fill ten they become cun, when cun fill ten they become chi; subtract from the winter-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant — the sought gnomon-shadow fixed number.

units.zh: 視夏至後初限、冬至後末限，百通日，內分，自相乘為上位。
units.en: After summer solstice in the initial limit or after winter solstice in the final limit: multiply the day count by one hundred, include the fen, and square the product for the upper position.
units.literal: For after summer solstice in the initial limit and after winter solstice in the final limit: multiply the day count by one hundred and include the fen, self-multiply for the upper position.

units.zh: 下置入限分，以二百二十五乘，百約之，加一十九萬八千七十五為法。
units.en: Set the entered limit fen below, multiply by 225, reduce by one hundred, and add 198,075 to form the divisor.
units.literal: Below set the entered limit fen, multiply by 225, reduce by one hundred, add 198,075 for the divisor.

units.zh: 夏至前後半限以上者，減去半限，列於上位。
units.en: When before or after summer solstice the value reaches half the limit or above, subtract half the limit and place the result in the upper position.
units.literal: For before and after summer solstice at half the limit or above, subtract half the limit and place it in the upper position.

units.zh: 下位置半限。
units.en: Set half the limit below.
units.literal: Below set half the limit.

units.zh: 各百通日，內分，先相減，後相乘。
units.en: In each case multiply the day count by one hundred with the fen included, subtract first, then multiply.
units.literal: For each, multiply the day count by one hundred and include the fen; subtract first, then multiply.

units.zh: 以七千七百除之，所得以加其法反除上位，為分，分滿十為寸，寸滿十為尺，用加夏至地中晷影常數，為所求晷影定數。
units.en: Divide by 7,700, add the quotient to the divisor, and divide the upper position to obtain fen; ten fen make one cun and ten cun one chi; add to the summer-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant to obtain the sought gnomon-shadow fixed number.
units.literal: Divide by 7,700; add the result to the divisor and divide the upper position in reverse for fen; when fen fill ten they become cun, when cun fill ten they become chi; add to the summer-solstice geocentric gnomon-shadow constant — the sought gnomon-shadow fixed number.

units.zh: 求四方所在晷影
units.en: To find the gnomon shadow at each of the four directions.
units.literal: To find the gnomon shadow at each of the four directions.

units.zh: 各於其處測冬夏二至晷影，乃相減之餘，為其處二至晷差。
units.en: At each place measure the winter and summer solstice gnomon shadows; their difference is that place's solstice gnomon difference.
units.literal: At each place measure the winter and summer solstice gnomon shadows; the remainder after mutual subtraction is that place's solstice gnomon difference.

units.zh: 亦以地中二至晷數相減，為地中二至晷差。
units.en: Subtract the geocentric solstice gnomon figures likewise to obtain the geocentric solstice gnomon difference.
units.literal: Also subtract the geocentric solstice gnomon figures mutually — the geocentric solstice gnomon difference.

units.zh: 其所求日在冬至後初限、夏至後末限者，如在半限以下，倍之；
units.en: When the sought day falls after winter solstice in the initial limit or after summer solstice in the final limit: if at or below half the limit, double it;
units.literal: When the sought day is after winter solstice in the initial limit or after summer solstice in the final limit: if at or below half the limit, double it;

units.zh: 半限以上，覆減半限，餘亦倍之，併入限日，三因折半，以日為分，十為寸，以減地中二至晷差為法。
units.en: if above half the limit, cover and subtract half the limit and double the remainder, combine with the entered limit days, multiply by three and halve, take days as fen and ten as cun, and subtract from the geocentric solstice gnomon difference to form the divisor.
units.literal: if above half the limit, cover and subtract half the limit, double the remainder also, combine with the entered limit days, multiply by three and halve, take days as fen and ten as cun — subtract from the geocentric solstice gnomon difference for the divisor.

units.zh: 置地中冬至晷影常數，以所求日地中晷影定數減之，餘以其年二至晷差乘之為實。
units.en: Set the geocentric winter-solstice gnomon-shadow constant, subtract the sought day's geocentric gnomon-shadow fixed number, and multiply the remainder by that year's solstice gnomon difference for the dividend.
units.literal: Set the geocentric winter-solstice gnomon-shadow constant; subtract the sought day's geocentric gnomon-shadow fixed number; multiply the remainder by that year's solstice gnomon difference for the dividend.

units.zh: 實如法而一，所得，以減其處冬至晷數，即得其處其日晷影定數。
units.en: Divide the dividend by the divisor and subtract the quotient from that place's winter-solstice gnomon figure to obtain that place's gnomon-shadow fixed number for the day.
units.literal: Divide the dividend by the divisor; subtract the result from that place's winter-solstice gnomon figure — that place's gnomon-shadow fixed number for the day.

units.zh: 所求日在夏至後初限、冬至後末限者，如在半限以下，倍之；
units.en: When the sought day falls after summer solstice in the initial limit or after winter solstice in the final limit: if at or below half the limit, double it;
units.literal: When the sought day is after summer solstice in the initial limit or after winter solstice in the final limit: if at or below half the limit, double it;

units.zh: 半限以上，覆減半限，餘亦倍之，併入限日，三因四除，以日為分，十為寸，以加地中二至晷差為法。
units.en: if above half the limit, cover and subtract half the limit and double the remainder, combine with the entered limit days, multiply by three and divide by four, take days as fen and ten as cun, and add to the geocentric solstice gnomon difference to form the divisor.
units.literal: if above half the limit, cover and subtract half the limit, double the remainder also, combine with the entered limit days, multiply by three and divide by four, take days as fen and ten as cun — add to the geocentric solstice gnomon difference for the divisor.

units.zh: 置所求日地中晷影定數，以地中夏至晷影常數減之，餘以其處二至晷差乘之為實。
units.en: Set the sought day's geocentric gnomon-shadow fixed number, subtract the geocentric summer-solstice gnomon-shadow constant, and multiply the remainder by that place's solstice gnomon difference for the dividend.
units.literal: Set the sought day's geocentric gnomon-shadow fixed number; subtract the geocentric summer-solstice gnomon-shadow constant; multiply the remainder by that place's solstice gnomon difference for the dividend.

units.zh: 實如法而一，所得，以加其處夏至晷數，即得其處其日晷影定數。
units.en: Divide the dividend by the divisor and add the quotient to that place's summer-solstice gnomon figure to obtain that place's gnomon-shadow fixed number for the day.
units.literal: Divide the dividend by the divisor; add the result to that place's summer-solstice gnomon figure — that place's gnomon-shadow fixed number for the day.

units.zh: 二十四氣陟降及日出分
units.en: Twenty-four qi ascension–descension and sunrise fen.
units.literal: Twenty-four qi ascension–descension and sunrise fen.

units.zh: 二分前後陟降率
units.en: Ascension–descension rates before and after the two equinoxes.
units.literal: Ascension–descension rates before and after the two equinoxes.

units.zh: 春分前三日太陽入赤道內，秋分後三日太陽出赤道外，故其陟降與他日不倫，今各別立數而用之。
units.en: Three days before the vernal equinox the sun enters inside the equator, and three days after the autumnal equinox it emerges outside it — so its ascension and descension diverge from ordinary days; separate rates are therefore assigned for each period.
units.literal: Three days before the vernal equinox the sun enters within the equator; three days after the autumnal equinox it emerges outside the equator — therefore its ascension and descension are unlike other days; now separate numbers are set for each and used.

units.zh: 驚蟄，十二日，陟四六十七，一十六此為末率，于此用畢。
units.en: Awakening of Insects, day twelve: ascend 467, 116 — the final rate; use ends here.
units.literal: Awakening of Insects, day twelve: ascend 467, 116 — this is the final rate; use ends here.

units.zh: 其減差亦止於此。
units.en: The decrease-difference likewise ends here.
units.literal: The decrease-difference also stops here.

units.zh: 十三日，陟四四十一，六。
units.en: Day thirteen: ascend 441, 6.
units.literal: Day thirteen: ascend 441, 6.

units.zh: 十四日，陟四三十六，九十。
units.en: Day fourteen: ascend 436, 90.
units.literal: Day fourteen: ascend 436, 90.

units.zh: 十五日，陟四一。
units.en: Day fifteen: ascend 41.
units.literal: Day fifteen: ascend 41.

units.zh: 秋分，初日，降四三十八。
units.en: Autumnal Equinox, first day: descend 438.
units.literal: Autumnal Equinox, first day: descend 438.

units.zh: 一日，降四三十九。
units.en: Day one: descend 439.
units.literal: Day one: descend 439.

units.zh: 二日，降四五十七。
units.en: Day two: descend 457.
units.literal: Day two: descend 457.

units.zh: 三日降四六十八。
units.en: Day three: descend 468.
units.literal: Day three: descend 468.

units.zh: 此為初率，始用之。
units.en: This is the initial rate; use begins here.
units.literal: This is the initial rate; use begins here.

units.zh: 其加差亦始於此。
units.en: The increase-difference likewise begins here.
units.literal: The increase-difference also begins here.

units.zh: 求每日出入晨昏半晝分
units.en: To find the daily exit and entry, dawn and dusk, and half-daylight fen.
units.literal: To find the daily exit and entry, dawn and dusk, and half-daylight fen.

units.zh: 各以陟降初率，陟減降加其氣初日日出分，為一日下日出分。
units.en: Take the ascension–descension initial rate for each qi, subtract ascension and add descension to that qi's first-day sunrise fen, and obtain the sunrise fen for the day below.
units.literal: For each, with the ascension–descension initial rate, subtract ascension and add descension to that qi's first-day sunrise fen — the sunrise fen below day one.

units.zh: 以增損差，仍加減加減差。
units.en: Apply the increase-decrease difference and continue adding and subtracting the adjustment difference.
units.literal: With the increase-decrease difference, still add and subtract the add-and-subtract difference.

units.zh: 增損陟降率，馴積而加減之，即為每日日出分。
units.en: Adjust the ascension–descension rate and stepwise accumulate the additions and subtractions to obtain the daily sunrise fen.
units.literal: Increase and decrease the ascension–descension rate, stepwise accumulating to add and subtract — that is the daily sunrise fen.

units.zh: 覆減日法，餘為日入分。
units.en: Cover and subtract from the day factor; the remainder is sunset fen.
units.literal: Cover and subtract the day factor; the remainder is sunset fen.

units.zh: 以日出分日入分而半之，為半晝分。
units.en: Halve the sunrise and sunset fen together to obtain half-daylight fen.
units.literal: Halve the sunrise and sunset fen together — half-daylight fen.

units.zh: 以昏明分減日出分為晨分，加日入分為昏分。
units.en: Subtract dusk-and-dawn fen from sunrise fen for dawn fen; add it to sunset fen for dusk fen.
units.literal: Subtract dusk-and-dawn fen from sunrise fen for dawn fen; add to sunset fen for dusk fen.

units.zh: 求日出入辰刻
units.en: To find the double-hours and ke of exit and entry.
units.literal: To find the double-hours and ke of exit and entry.

units.zh: 置日出入分，以六因之，滿辰法而一，為辰數，不盡，刻法除之為刻數，不滿為分，命子正算外，即得所求。
units.en: Set the exit-and-entry fen, multiply by six, and divide by the chen divisor for the chen count; divide any remainder by the ke factor for ke, with the unfilled portion as fen; count outward from zi zheng to obtain the result.
units.literal: Set exit-and-entry fen, multiply by six; divide by the chen divisor for chen count; what does not exhaust, divide by the ke factor for ke count; what does not fill is fen; count outside zi zheng — the sought result.

units.zh: 求晝夜刻
units.en: To find day and night ke.
units.literal: To find day and night ke.

units.zh: 置日出分，十二乘之，刻法而一，為刻，不滿為分，即為夜刻。
units.en: Set sunrise fen, multiply by twelve, and divide by the ke factor for ke, with the unfilled portion as fen — that is night ke.
units.literal: Set sunrise fen, multiply by twelve, divide by the ke factor for ke; what does not fill is fen — night ke.

units.zh: 覆減百刻，餘為晝刻。
units.en: Cover and subtract from one hundred ke; the remainder is day ke.
units.literal: Cover and subtract from one hundred ke; the remainder is day ke.

units.zh: 求更點率
units.en: To find the geng and point rates.
units.literal: To find the geng and point rates.

units.zh: 置晨分，四因，退位為更率。
units.en: Set dawn fen, multiply by four, and step back one place to obtain the geng rate.
units.literal: Set dawn fen, multiply by four, step back one place for the geng rate.

units.zh: 二因更率，退位為點率。
units.en: Multiply the geng rate by two and step back one place to obtain the point rate.
units.literal: Multiply the geng rate by two, step back one place for the point rate.

units.zh: 求更點所在辰刻
units.en: To find the double-hour and ke where a geng or point falls.
units.literal: To find the double-hour and ke where a geng or point falls.

units.zh: 置更點率，以所求更點數因之，又六因，內加昏明分，滿辰法而一，為辰數。
units.en: Set the geng or point rate, multiply by the sought number of geng or points and again by six, add dusk-and-dawn fen within, and divide by the chen divisor for the chen count.
units.literal: Set the geng or point rate, multiply by the sought number of geng or points, multiply again by six, include and add dusk-and-dawn fen; divide by the chen divisor for chen count.

units.zh: 不盡，滿刻法除之為刻數，不滿為分，命其辰刻算外，即得所求。
units.en: Divide any remainder by the ke factor for ke, with the unfilled portion as fen, and count outward from that chen and ke to obtain the result.
units.literal: What does not exhaust, divide by the ke factor for ke count; what does not fill is fen; count outside that chen and ke — the sought result.

units.zh: 求四方所在漏刻
units.en: To find the clepsydra graduations at each of the four directions.
units.literal: To find the clepsydra graduations at each of the four directions.

units.zh: 各於所在下水漏，以定其處冬至或夏至夜刻，乃與五十刻相減，餘為至差刻。
units.en: At each place run the water clepsydra to fix the winter- or summer-solstice night ke, subtract it from fifty ke, and take the remainder as the solstice-difference ke.
units.literal: At each place lower the water clepsydra to fix that place's winter- or summer-solstice night ke; subtract from fifty ke — the remainder is the solstice-difference ke.

units.zh: 置所求日黃道去赤道內外度及分，以至差刻乘之，進一位，如二百三十九而一，為刻，不盡以刻法乘之，退除為分，內減外加五十刻，即所求日夜刻，以減百刻，餘為晝刻。
units.en: Set the sought day's ecliptic distance inside or outside the equator with fen, multiply by the solstice-difference ke and advance one place, divide by 239 for ke, convert any remainder through the ke factor into fen, subtract within and add without fifty ke for night ke, and subtract from one hundred ke for day ke.
units.literal: Set the sought day's ecliptic distance inside or outside the equator with fen; multiply by the solstice-difference ke, advance one place, divide by 239 for ke; what does not exhaust, multiply by the ke factor and step back for fen; subtract within and add without fifty ke — the sought day's night ke; subtract from one hundred ke — day ke.

units.zh: 其日出入辰刻及更點差率算等，並依術求之。
units.en: The day's exit-and-entry chen and ke, together with the geng and point differential rates and related reckonings, are all found by the same procedures.
units.literal: The day's exit-and-entry chen and ke, and the geng and point differential rates and other reckonings, are all sought by the procedures.

units.zh: 求黃道內外度
units.en: To find ecliptic inner and outer degrees.
units.literal: To find ecliptic inner and outer degrees.

units.zh: 置日出分，如日法四分之一以上，去之，餘為外分。
units.en: Set sunrise fen; if it reaches one-fourth of the day factor or above, remove that portion — the remainder is outer fen.
units.literal: Set sunrise fen; if at one-fourth of the day factor or above, remove it — the remainder is outer fen.

units.zh: 如日法四分之一以下，覆減之，餘為內分。
units.en: If it falls at one-fourth of the day factor or below, cover and subtract — the remainder is inner fen.
units.literal: If at one-fourth of the day factor or below, cover and subtract — the remainder is inner fen.

units.zh: 置內外分，千乘之，如內外法而一，為度，不滿退除為分，即為黃道去赤道內外度。
units.en: Set inner and outer fen, multiply by one thousand, divide by the inner-outer factor for degrees, and convert any remainder into fen — the ecliptic distance inside or outside the equator.
units.literal: Set inner and outer fen, multiply by one thousand, divide by the inner-outer factor for degrees; what does not fill, step back and divide for fen — ecliptic distance inside or outside the equator.

units.zh: 內減外加象限，即得內道去極度。
units.en: Subtract within and add without the quadrant limit to obtain the inner path's distance from the pole.
units.literal: Subtract within and add without the quadrant limit — distance of the inner path from the pole.

units.zh: 求距中度及更差度
units.en: To find the distance-from-center degree and the geng differential degree.
units.literal: To find the distance-from-center degree and the geng differential degree.

units.zh: 置半法，以晨分減之，餘為距中分，百乘之，如周法而一，為距中度。
units.en: Set the half factor and subtract dawn fen; multiply the remainder by one hundred and divide by the circumference factor for distance-from-center degrees.
units.literal: Set the half factor, subtract dawn fen — the remainder is distance-from-center fen; multiply by one hundred, divide by the circumference factor for distance-from-center degrees.

units.zh: 用減一百八十三度一十二分八十四秒，餘四因退位，為每更差度。
units.en: Subtract from 183°12′84″, multiply the remainder by four, and step back one place to obtain the differential degree for each geng.
units.literal: Subtract from 183 degrees 12 fen 84 miao; multiply the remainder by four and step back one place — the differential degree for each geng.

units.zh: 求昏明五更中星
units.en: To find the culmination stars at dusk, dawn, and the five geng.
units.literal: To find the culmination stars at dusk, dawn, and the five geng.

units.zh: 置距中度，以其日午中赤道日度加而命之，即昏中星所格宿次，因為初更中星。
units.en: Set the distance-from-center degree, add that day's noon equatorial solar degree and assign the mansions — the lodge of dusk culmination, which is also the first-geng culmination star.
units.literal: Set the distance-from-center degree, add that day's noon equatorial solar degree and assign the mansions — the lodge where dusk culmination falls, and thus the first-geng culmination star.

units.zh: 以更差度累加之，命赤道宿次去之，即得逐更及明中星。
units.en: Add the geng differential degree cumulatively, assign the equatorial mansions and cast out full circuits — thus obtain the culmination stars for each successive geng and at dawn.
units.literal: Add the geng differential degree cumulatively, assign the equatorial mansions and remove — thus obtain the culmination stars for each successive geng and at dawn.
